description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for `ChannelsSettings`, defining the UI layout and behavior for a channels configuration interface within an app, including sidebar and detail views, selection handling, and visual styling.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Builds the sidebar view listing enabled and available channels with section headers.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays the detail view of the selected channel or an empty placeholder.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view prompting user to select a channel.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detailed view for a specific channel, including header and section content.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Creates a clickable row representing a channel in the sidebar, highlighting selection.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Generates a section header label within the sidebar.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Constructs the header section of the channel detail view with status badge and actions.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Creates a styled badge displaying channel status text.
